editorial:
Imagine you are a quiet traveler just drifting through life, loving the art of bullfighting but avoiding any real trouble. That is exactly how you start with Jack, a peaceful guy who finds himself in the wrong place at the worst possible time. After a crime boss's daughter is accidentally killed by a bull, the big boss blames Jack and sends a massive army of killers after him. You get a wild mix of a dusty Western and a high-stakes thriller as Jack runs for his life across a brutal desert. It feels like a fever dream where the action never stops and the odds are always stacked against our main guy.

You will love how the movie blends comedy with intense shootouts, though some parts of the plot move a bit slow before the chaos hits. The action scenes are the real highlight, making you feel the heat of the sand and the smoke of the guns. If you enjoy stories about a regular person fighting against a powerful empire, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Jack stops running and faces the hitmen in a massive battle. He uses his knowledge of the terrain and bullfighting tricks to outsmart the killers. After a bloody fight, Jack manages to take down the crime boss and his remaining men. He finally faces his inner demons and finds peace, surviving the night. He walks away from the wreckage, finally free to wander the world without a target on his back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves underdog stories and wild shootouts.
